statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
A mobile cardiac telemetry study is ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring.
CPT code 93229 was billed for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
Diagnosis codes R00.2 and R42 were submitted with the claim.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197.
The denial was because required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date.
